_comment: Section/heading detection patterns — DATA, not code (charter rule 7).
An instructor-facing format that numbers or names sections differently
is accommodated by editing this file (or pointing INGEST_PATTERNS_FILE
at a copy), never by changing logic. Regexes are Python `re` syntax;
uppercase-start requirement filters numbered list items).
caption: ^(?:table|figure|fig\.)\s+\d

_comment: V-063: deterministic title-page extraction (group name, members,
